text_block_list.text:
――I wanted to do something about Katsuragi
Ace's homesickness. 
With that in mind, I bought several books,
including one 
titled 『My First Kitchen Garden』.

If I can learn this properly,
then I should be able 
to help her alleviate some of that
loneliness――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that Trainer-san? Whoa,
that looks like 
a really heavy bag there. Is it all books?
choice_data_list: Yeah, just something I wanted to learn
Yeah, just something I wanted to learn

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're studying on your days off too!? 
……Haa~,
sounds like being a trainer is pretty
rough.
choice_data_list: Well, it's not work-related though――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've made up my mind! 
Let's take it easy today! Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day you were so worn out, 
so once in a while should be fine, right? 
C'mon,
I'll lead the way! ――To my secret base!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And, we're here! What do you think,
Trainer-san? 
It's just run-down enough to make it perfect,
don't you think?
choice_data_list: Ace, do you come here often?
Ace, do you come here often?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm……it's more like,
before I realize it, I end up here,
I guess? The air reminds me 
of home,
and it just some how calms me down!

text_block_list.name: Young Ace
text_block_list.text: ――HaaaaAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Neighborly Old Man
text_block_list.text:
There, go for it, go for it! 
Waahaaha! You were really fast, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Neighborly Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ……Ace! If you're starting to get scared,
c'mon over here! 
This old lady's got some tea for ya.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wonder if that old man and woman are doing
well. It'd be 
nice if the radishes they're growing are
big this year too.
choice_data_list: Big radishes?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Y'see,
there was this big athletics competition 
we had back in our district.
In the Relay races, 
we'd use 『Radishes』 instead of batons!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Ahaaha! I guess it's natural you'd make 
a face like that! Just so you know,
afterwards 
we'd all eat those radishes! And then――

You could tell by the way Katsuragi Ace
talked 
about it, she really loved her hometown,
and 
the people in her hometown really loved
her.

Maybe that's why she felt so homesick.
She probably came to 
this place just so she could feel closer to
her hometown.

I may not be anything like the people from
her hometown,
but I wanted to do something about 
her loneliness,
even if it was just a little……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Trainer-san, this was meant to 
be a change of pace for you,
but I ended up 
talking so much……it was boring wasn't it?
choice_data_list: No, it was really fun
No, it was really fun

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
I'm glad! I'm starting to get hungry, 
so we should probably head back! ――Hm?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: 『My First Kitchen Garden』? This is……
choice_data_list: Ah……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So that 『Something I wanted to learn』 wasn't
something 
to do with training,
but it was about that field?

It's not like I was trying to hide it,
but it still felt awkward. 
With a wry smile,
I held the book in my hand.
choice_data_list: I wasn't ready to give up just yet

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There was no reason for you to worry about
what happened 
last time though.
You're already so busy after all……
choice_data_list: I meant about you
I meant about you

text_block_list.text:
The important thing was neither the fieldwork
nor fixing 
mistakes. It was to cheer up Katsuragi Ace,
just that.
choice_data_list: I don't want to give up on helping you
I don't want to give up on helping you

text_block_list.text:
Truthfully,
there probably wasn't much I could help
with. 
But, even just going from 0 to 1 was worth it.
So――
choice_data_list: Let me help with the field!
Let me help with the field!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san…… 
――Got it. That spirit, I'll accept it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's do the fieldwork!
It'll be really early in the morning, 
so I don't want to hear any complaints,
got it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's right! If we're doing this,
we might as well study 
together too!
If there's anything you don't get,
I'll teach ya!
Several days later――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Hmmm~, like this,
there's too much leftover. 
When thinning these out,
it's fine to go rougher!
choice_data_list: I-is that so……?
I-is that so……?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Guess that's about it for this spot. 
……Trainer-san!
How's it looking over there~?
choice_data_list: W-with just a bit more time……!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, these rows look just about ready, 
next is the fertilizer……
choice_data_list: Ace, come look at this!
Ace, come look at this!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ……Oooh, awesome!
Did you do this entire line!? The balance 
is perfect.
Trainer-san you're a pretty quick learner,
huh~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: But――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You've got dirt on you here, you know? 
……And, got it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, seems like you're a little lacking here,
huh~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then,
let's get the rest of it all wrapped up! 
Trainer-san, I'll leave that side to you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――And you see,
on those leaves was another caterpillar, 
but, this time Trainer-san got it and
released 
it themself without so much as a peep~.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mom
text_block_list.text:
『Oh~ isn't that amazing!?
Last time you told 
me they just fell all over themself, too』

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mom
text_block_list.text:
『……But I'm glad,
looks like you're doing well! Last time 
we talked,
you seemed a little off so I was worried』

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mom
text_block_list.text:
『Guess it really is better to work the
fields 
together with someone,
huh~. I'd be really 
lonely if I was alone too, you know!』

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, I guess so! 
Yeah……it really does seem like that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, before Trainer-san gets here, 
guess I'll do a quick check for bugs~……oh,
ah.
choice_data_list: M-morning, Ace! It's cold today, huh
M-morning, Ace! It's cold today, huh

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――Oh! Morning, Trainer-san! 
……Ah,
Hahaa!
That's some wild bed head ya got there!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Mom's right. Since I came here,
I guess I was 
getting used to doing the work alone,
but……)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(In the dim light,
just having someone respond. And 
having someone to wipe off the last bit of
dirt on my face.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(With just something like that,
with just that……I――)

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mom
text_block_list.text:
『――Well then,
talk to you later.
If you ever feel you're 
missing home,
you're welcome to come back anytime』

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks, Mom. 
……but I'm fine,
there's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――Because,
I have Trainer-san with me after all.
